findings.evidence: python -B scripts\arena_filework.py --grade --run-id fw-hard-20260919 raises AttributeError: Namespace object has no attribute usage at grade line 304. main does not register --usage.
Read-only synthetic _usage_by_pair invocation with the same pair_id and attempts carrying 100+10 and 200+20 tokens returns only 220, not 330. Dictionary assignment overwrites earlier attempts.
Model reducer sums only present usage/cost then divides by all accepted results. Missing spend is silently excluded. Read-only expression for [0.10, None] returns 0.10 instead of unavailable.
_usd supports explicit zero prices but aggregate uses sum(...) or None and denominator expressions use truthiness, collapsing legitimate zero into unknown.
Both enabled roster entries lack usd_per_1m_input and usd_per_1m_output. Runtime-reported zero costs do not prove zero economic cost for subscription usage.
